title: The only question left: is it, simply speaking, natural or supernatural?
source_text: XXVIII. Quaestio solum remanet An simpliciter loquendo immortalitas ista dici potius debeat naturalis quam supernaturalis Respectu hominis integri? Quod affirmant Protestantes, Doctores vero Scholae Romanae negant.
pass_a_gloss: The Question only remains Whether, speaking simply, that immortality ought rather to be called natural than supernatural In respect of integral man? Which the Protestants affirm, but the Doctors of the Roman School deny.
pass_b_english: The only question left is whether, simply speaking, this immortality should be called natural rather than supernatural with respect to unfallen man. The Protestants say yes; the teachers of the Roman school say no.

choices.english: The Protestants say yes; the teachers of the Roman school say no
choices.why: Plain affirm/deny keeps the two sides in Le Blanc's order.
